input.quote: 28.2 The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction, and each Party irrevocably submits to personal jurisdiction and waives any objection based on venue or inconvenient forum.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects the laws of the State of New York and Section 28.2 confers exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County — exactly the playbook's preferred position on both governing law and venue. A document-wide search returned no arbitration provision, so there is no foreign-seated arbitration risk despite Vendor being an English Ltd. The 28.2 carve-out for temporary injunctive relief is mutual and narrow (confidential information / IP) and does not displace the exclusive court venue; the 28.3 pre-filing executive escalation expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings. Section 29 notices are consistent and raise no service-of-process conflict. No redline required.
